name: Brake System Variant Selection (Disambiguation)
description: Two braking configurations: electrodynamic (ED) braking (lower wear, uncertain force at low speed) and friction braking (constant force). Disambiguation UPR selects the appropriate braking force CZ based on speed range.

elements.name: ED Brake Force (High Speed)
elements.description: Electrodynamic braking force available above 30 km/h.

uncertainty.source: EN 14531 braking calculations: electrodynamic brake characteristic above 30 km/h

elements.name: Minimum Braking Force
elements.description: EN 14531: minimum braking force for deceleration performance requirement

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ*(speed) = Select{CZ_ed=[100±15], CZ_friction=[90±15]} — both checked against F_min=70 kN
